Coattail Leap.name: Coattail Leap
Coattail Leap.description: The user taps a person whose Quirk moves them, such as a jumper, a flyer or a speedster, and uses the copy in the same motion. This turn the copy carries the user wherever it could carry its owner: onto a rooftop, across a street-wide gap or out of a fall into a safe landing, with a single passenger if they choose. Strain: moderate.
